opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: covers the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish Higher Education Institution, who are not eligible for government tuition fee support. Must have completed at least two years of secondary schooling or college education in Scotland, or demonstrate a substantial and recent connection to Scotland. Must be entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, have Limited Leave to Remain, or be an asylum seeker.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to cover tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for students from low-income households who are ineligible for Scottish Government tuition fee support and are enrolled on an undergraduate degree at a Scottish institution. Includes a second-degree reskilling route for graduates in skills-shortage areas.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and University of Edinburgh), studying part-time or full-time. Must be ordinarily resident in Scotland, entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, and not have already obtained a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: A scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh that covers full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus a £1,200 living-cost bursary, to widen participation in postgraduate study in plant science and botany.
